items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: I was doing a show with a gentleman named Terry Waldo... So I was part of the show

ctx.x: How did you get hooked up with Dr. Vollmer and the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band?

I was doing a show with a gentleman named Terry Waldo, who specializes in ragtime music and all the old tunes. And he studied with Eubie Blake and I think he worked on some of his music categorizing it or cataloguing it. And Terry was doing a show where Shea Stadium was, the old World’s Fair was there, one of the old World’s Fairs. And it was called “Shake That Thing.” Why do I have to be in shows like “Shake That Thing” and “One Mo’ Time.” So I was part of the show and Al saw me in that and called me to…
And is it my, am I right in guessing that there was probably no rehearsal?
